text: i would log it as a starting point, log all of it and see what the problem is
resolution: Per the user's instruction to 'log it as a starting point, log all of it and see what the problem is', added staged memory + size instrumentation to the bake instead of theorizing: a /proc/self/status RSS+peak probe (memStage) at each pipeline stage in bakeGameFile.ts, byte-size logs for mapContainer/writeGameFile/base64/JSON, and an instance-buffer size log in worldGeometry.ts. Run under /usr/bin/time -v this localized the OOM precisely to the base64+JSON emit stage (world gen peaked at a comfortable 490MB; crash came right after writeGameFile at 70MB). The logging stays in (bake-only, stderr) as early-warning telemetry for a growing world. This directly drove the req_1584/req_1586 fix.
